arguments.query: SELECT status, channel, COUNT(*), MIN(order_ts), MAX(order_ts) FROM orders GROUP BY status, channel
SELECT o.status, p.payment_status, COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY 1,2
SELECT o.status, COUNT(s.shipment_id), COUNT(s.delivered_ts), COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY 1
SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(channel="web")/COUNT(*),2), COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status IN (1,2,3) AND order_ts>="2025-01-01" AND order_ts<"2026-01-01"
